title: My First Blog
text:
Ali started a blog about his hobby, cooking. He writes a new post every Monday. At first, he only wrote about simple soups. Now he also shares recipes for cakes and bread.

Last month, Ali wrote about his grandmother's soup. Many readers wrote comments and said they wanted to try the recipe. Ali was very happy, so he decided to write more posts about family food. He thinks the blog is a good way to share his love of cooking.

questions.text: How often does Ali write a new post?
What did Ali write about last month?
What can we infer about Ali's readers?
options: They want to cook the dishes he shares

questions.text: Why did Ali decide to write more posts about family food?
options: He was happy about the response from readers
His family asked him to stop

vocabulary.definition: short written replies that people post under an article
lists of ingredients and instructions for making food
an activity that you do for pleasure in your free time
people who read a book, article or blog

paragraph_translations: Ali, yemek pişirmek olan hobisi hakkında bir blog başlattı. Her pazartesi yeni bir yazı yazıyor. İlk başta sadece basit çorbalar hakkında yazıyordu. Şimdi pastalar ve ekmek tarifleri de paylaşıyor.

Geçen ay Ali, büyükannesinin çorbası hakkında yazdı. Birçok okuyucu yorum yazdı ve tarifi denemek istediklerini söylediler. Ali çok mutlu oldu, bu yüzden aile yemekleri hakkında daha fazla yazı yazmaya karar verdi. Blogun, yemek pişirme sevgisini paylaşmanın güzel bir yolu olduğunu düşünüyor.
